verdict.rationale: Zep documents graph search that combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search, so hybrid and keyword matching are built in. It also exposes a `scope` parameter, including `scope="auto"`, which steers retrieval across edges, nodes, episodes, observations and thread summaries. The pack does not show that a developer can choose a keyword-only or semantic-only mode, apply metadata filters, or pick a reranker, so only part of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented metadata/attribute filters, selectable search modes, configurable reranking options, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can steer retrieval with metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking instead of accepting a single fixed similarity search

citations.quote: Zep graph search combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search. Semantic search finds conceptual matches, and full-text search finds exact terms.
set scope="auto" and let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block.
